sections.title: New
items: List, carousel, and coverflow modes now display the scene's performer(s) and resolution. Carousel mode also includes a brief scene description.
The player's top bar now names the scene's performer(s) and shows the file's resolution.
With the controls hidden, up and down raise the bar instead of changing scene.
Slideshow interval is now a setting: 3, 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Minor bug fixes.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Some focus previews (~100 fps files) flashed the whole screen black; those cards now keep their cover and preview doesn't play.
Coverflow focus previews play instead of covering the card with a black tile.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Skipping forward or back no longer stalls on the old frame when the TV misses a seek; recovery begins as soon as the new position is given its chance to land.
Opening a performer starts on their first scene when they have one.
Back from a performer opened on a scene returns to that scene's card in the listing, not the first card.
Numeric filters name what the value counts, so duration reads "seconds" and height reads "cm" instead of a bare number.
Minor bug fixes.

sections.title: New
items: Settings opens Changelog: the changes in the newest releases, read from the project's changelog. It works whether an update is waiting or not.
A long press on a scene card now offers Mark played, Add O, Clear resume and Mark organised, so those edits no longer need the scene page.
Cards carry small marks for watched, organised and the O count, so library state is visible while browsing.
Settings has a Remote help guide: every key for browsing, the card menu, the player, the image viewer and typing, without the README.
Search now includes markers, remembers recent searches as one-press chips and offers Retry when a section fails to load.
A performer page has Play all and Shuffle, which play their scenes under the page's current sort, filter and search.
If the Stash server cannot be reached, a banner on every screen says so and offers Retry, so a spell of Wi-Fi trouble no longer looks like a broken app.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Focus previews wait until every cover on the page has loaded, so a listing fills exactly as it does with previews off. The preview still appears on the focused card, a little later.
Changing transcode quality while paused no longer starts playback.
A failed load at the end of a queue no longer ends the queue: the next press retries.
And other bug fixes.

sections.title: Changes
items: Quick edits from the Info sheet: favourites, ratings, organised and O count.
Favourite tags and studios show a star on their cards.
Delete a saved filter from the filter builder; press twice to confirm.
Transcode quality and playback speed in Settings and the player's options.
Quick filters on a performer's scenes.
Cover art and playback now work when Stash uses an external host.
Unwatched now treats a scene with watch time or a resume point as watched.
And other minor bug fixes.
